title: Cobra Venom Stops Your Breathing. This Animal Shrugs It Off
subject: honey badger

scenes.text: Cobra venom shuts down your breathing. This animal ignores it.
The venom works by blocking a receptor on your muscles, so the signal to breathe never lands.
The honey badger's receptor has a tiny change that stops the venom fitting.
Scientists found the same trick evolved on its own in hedgehogs and pigs.
Mongooses resist it too, by a different change on the same spot.
It's not courage. It's a receptor the cobra can't grab.

description:
Cobra venom stops your muscles and your breathing. The honey badger shrugs it off.
Its muscle receptor changed in a way the venom can't grab, and hedgehogs and pigs evolved the same trick on their own.
Which animal would you bet on against a cobra?
